body: My entry says the orchard crew rinsed its sprayer upstream. The water turned milky, and my hands blistered before the bridge was blocked.
title: camp notebook, page torn short
gloss: A personal trace links farm-program residue to symptoms before a restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while crossing treated land; the personal trace does not by itself prove the farm program caused the emergency.

title: Supplies for the wrong route
body: The survivalist had packed for a three-day hike along the official safe corridor. At its first crossing a new barrier sent him back toward the town he had left. He wrote the change in the margin so he would not trust the printed route again.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
